targetProfile.operationMix: Alternating ASME classes 300 and 600 on Flan1; independent accounts and tabs

rationale.browser: Keep routine interaction near two seconds or below on the measured workstation. Search includes opening the dialog and entering the query.
rationale.concurrency: Use two clients as the candidate profile. The earlier run with four clients raised tail latency without improving throughput.
rationale.memory: Reserve less than one GiB for the Next server on the measured eight-GiB workstation, leaving headroom for the browser, PostgreSQL and OS.
rationale.response: Watch regression in this Flan1 class-change workload against the observed approximately 106 KiB decoded response. These are evidence limits and do not truncate results.
rationale.resume: Treat the cold resume as a smoke measurement and label its single observation. A repeatable percentile would require repeated restarts.
